### valkey-io/valkey (valkey/valkey)

### [`v9.2.0`](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/releases/tag/9.2.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/compare/9.1.4...9.2.0)

## Valkey 9.2.0 GA  -  Released Wed 18 November 2026

Upgrade urgency LOW: This is the first stable release of Valkey 9.2.

##### Behavior Changes

- `ZRANGEBYSCORE`, `ZREVRANGEBYSCORE`, `ZCOUNT`, and `ZRANGESTORE` now reject a bare `(` or an empty string as a score bound instead of silently treating it as 0 by [@​AlisinaDevelo](https://redirect.github.com/AlisinaDevelo) ([#​4054](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4054))
- Path Hash deletion commands now remove the key when the last path is deleted, following the Hash key lifecycle and emitting a generic del event by [@​yangbodong22011](https://redirect.github.com/yangbodong22011) ([#​5068](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5068))
- Active expiration of keys and hash fields now increments the dirty counter, so save points (and thus BGSAVE) may trigger more often by [@​enjoy-binbin](https://redirect.github.com/enjoy-binbin) ([#​3118](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3118))

##### New Features and Enhanced Behavior

- Add new `DELEX` command to conditionally delete a string key when its value matches (`IFEQ`) or differs from (`IFNE`) a given value by [@​lightsigma96](https://redirect.github.com/lightsigma96) ([#​4607](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4607))
- Add Zstd as a streaming compression codec for RDB persistence and replication, offering better compression ratios than LZ4 by [@​sarthakaggarwal97](https://redirect.github.com/sarthakaggarwal97) ([#​3798](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3798))
- Support streaming-compressed RDB preambles in AOF bases, so compressed full-sync RDB files can be reused directly as AOF bases by [@​sarthakaggarwal97](https://redirect.github.com/sarthakaggarwal97) ([#​4754](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4754))
- `ACL GENPASS` and the hash function seed draw randomness from the configured OpenSSL 3 provider when built with TLS, supporting deployments that require a validated crypto module by [@​MarkAtwood](https://redirect.github.com/MarkAtwood) ([#​4339](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4339))
- Support forkless full synchronization to replicas, serving disk and diskless full syncs from a background-thread snapshot without forking by [@​nitaicaro](https://redirect.github.com/nitaicaro) ([#​4797](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4797))
- Add ACL DIGEST command that returns a fingerprint of the ACL rules currently in effect, useful to verify what ACL LOAD applied by [@​melancholictheory](https://redirect.github.com/melancholictheory) ([#​4446](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4446))
- Add forkless RDB snapshots, opt-in via the new `forkless-infrastructure-enabled` and `bgsave-default-method` configs, with new INFO persistence fields reporting the save method and progress by [@​JimB123](https://redirect.github.com/JimB123) ([#​4460](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4460))
- Add the `XACKDEL` and `XDELEX` stream commands with `KEEPREF`, `DELREF` and `ACKED` modes to acknowledge and delete messages once consumer groups no longer need them by [@​nickiaq](https://redirect.github.com/nickiaq) ([#​4629](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4629))
- Support a secondary server certificate via `tls-alt-cert-file`, `tls-alt-key-file` and `tls-alt-key-file-pass`, e.g. a post-quantum certificate alongside RSA, with matching INFO TLS fields by [@​pkhartsk](https://redirect.github.com/pkhartsk) ([#​3717](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3717))
- Add ACL roles: named, reusable sets of ACL selectors managed with `ACL SETROLE`/`DELROLE`/`GETROLE`/`ROLES` and assigned to users with `role:<name>`, in commands, the ACL file and valkey.conf by [@​yang-z-o](https://redirect.github.com/yang-z-o) ([#​3967](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3967))
- Add a `maxmemory-scripts` config to limit memory used by cached `EVAL` scripts, and mark `SCRIPT LOAD` as DENYOOM so it respects the global maxmemory limit by [@​enjoy-binbin](https://redirect.github.com/enjoy-binbin) ([#​866](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/866))
- Add Path Hash, a new radix-tree-backed data type with `PH*` commands for exact lookup, longest-prefix matching, and prefix traversal over binary-safe paths by [@​yangbodong22011](https://redirect.github.com/yangbodong22011) ([#​4506](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4506))
- Support whole-stream LZ4 compression of RDB files via the new `rdbcompression lz4` option; the default per-string LZF behavior is unchanged by [@​sarthakaggarwal97](https://redirect.github.com/sarthakaggarwal97) ([#​3531](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3531))
- Add server-side hot key detection with new `HOTKEYS GET`/`RESET` commands, enabled by setting `hotkeys-top-k` by [@​alon-arenberg](https://redirect.github.com/alon-arenberg) ([#​3708](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3708))
- Add optional replication throttling (`repl-throttling-enabled`) that slows client writes when a replica falls behind, avoiding disconnects and full syncs by [@​harrylin98](https://redirect.github.com/harrylin98) ([#​4356](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4356))
- Prioritize system-critical events (cluster heartbeats, replication, slot migration) over heavy client traffic, tunable via the new `priority-preemptive-poll-interval-us` config by [@​satheeshaGowda](https://redirect.github.com/satheeshaGowda) ([#​4076](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4076))
- Reserve connection slots for administrative clients: connections from the CIDR ranges listed in the new `priority-subnets` config are tagged as prioritized, `maxclients-reserved` caps normal clients at `maxclients` minus that many slots, and `INFO clients` reports `connected_priority_clients` by [@​satheeshaGowda](https://redirect.github.com/satheeshaGowda) ([#​4005](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4005))
- Add `INCREX` command to atomically increment a key by an integer or float while setting its expiration, with `NX`/`XX` conditions by [@​GavinDmello](https://redirect.github.com/GavinDmello) ([#​3253](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3253))

##### Performance and Efficiency Improvements

- Fix long stalls in `SRANDMEMBER`, `ZRANDMEMBER`, `HRANDFIELD` and `SPOP` on a small key whose hashtable is still shrinking from a much larger size by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5170](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5170))
- Stop treating `LINDEX`, `LRANGE` and `LPOS` as format-changing commands during forkless background iteration, so list reads no longer get write-style handling by [@​JimB123](https://redirect.github.com/JimB123) ([#​5283](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5283))
- Keep the forkless save queue growing under write load by not counting keys expedited by writes as leftover work by [@​taham0](https://redirect.github.com/taham0) ([#​5298](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5298))
- Make BCAST client tracking cost scale with the prefixes a key matches instead of all registered prefixes, so many unmatched prefixes no longer slow writes and the event loop by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5183](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5183))
- Reclaim memory from sorted sets that shrink or have frequent score updates by compacting sparse B+tree leaves on delete by [@​rainsupreme](https://redirect.github.com/rainsupreme) ([#​4526](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4526))
- Speed up sorted set score updates in listpack encoding by replacing the score in place when the member keeps its position by [@​charsyam](https://redirect.github.com/charsyam) ([#​3491](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3491))
- Fix quadratic slowdown in `HRANDFIELD` and `SRANDMEMBER` with counts on collections whose elements differ only in letter case by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5167](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5167))
- Bound the time spent per cycle evicting keys from the client tracking table, avoiding long stalls after lowering `tracking-table-max-keys` by [@​tanmayBeginsJourney](https://redirect.github.com/tanmayBeginsJourney) ([#​4775](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4775))
- Speed up the `INFO` command by around 5% by pre-allocating the output buffer by [@​charsyam](https://redirect.github.com/charsyam) ([#​3413](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3413))
- Reclaim client-side caching tracking table entries left by disconnected clients, fixing a memory leak under read-heavy workloads, and include the tracking table in active defrag by [@​rayjinghaolei](https://redirect.github.com/rayjinghaolei) ([#​4190](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4190))
- Speed up `ZPOPMIN` and `ZPOPMAX` on B+tree encoded sorted sets by detaching edge items without a key search or copy by [@​charsyam](https://redirect.github.com/charsyam) ([#​4852](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4852))
- Counting a hash's fields with expirations is now O(1) for hashtable-encoded hashes by tracking the volatile set size on each mutation by [@​frostzt](https://redirect.github.com/frostzt) ([#​4829](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4829))
- Speed up AOF command propagation by serializing commands directly into the AOF buffer, removing an allocation and copy per command by [@​charsyam](https://redirect.github.com/charsyam) ([#​3496](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3496))
- Cache the earliest event-loop timer to avoid an O(N) scan per iteration, reducing overhead with many timers such as RDMA connections by [@​royenheart](https://redirect.github.com/royenheart) ([#​4354](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4354))
- Speed up HGETALL, HKEYS and HVALS with exact-length reply headers, fused bulk replies, and entry prefetching by [@​jjuleslasarte](https://redirect.github.com/jjuleslasarte) ([#​4417](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4417))
- Eliminate false sharing in per-thread memory usage counters, improving throughput with I/O threads on SMT x86 systems by [@​omerrubi-amzn](https://redirect.github.com/omerrubi-amzn) ([#​4107](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4107))
- Read-only list iteration (e.g. LRANGE, LPOS) no longer decompresses and recompresses quicklist nodes in place, cutting CPU cost on compressed lists by [@​murphyjacob4](https://redirect.github.com/murphyjacob4) ([#​4782](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4782))
- Speed up ZSCAN on btree-encoded sorted sets by avoiding temporary member and score copies and prefetching items by [@​charsyam](https://redirect.github.com/charsyam) ([#​4856](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4856))
- Reduce cache-line false sharing on IO thread activity and job counters for better multi-threaded IO performance by [@​omerrubi-amzn](https://redirect.github.com/omerrubi-amzn) ([#​4976](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4976))
- PHDELPREFIX now bounds its temporary path copies to 64KiB per batch, avoiding large untracked memory spikes on long shared prefixes by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5179](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5179))
- Speed up radix tree lookups and inserts by using SIMD-optimized memchr() for child-edge search by [@​charsyam](https://redirect.github.com/charsyam) ([#​3472](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3472))
- Improve replica processing speed by parsing multiple commands from the replication stream at once by [@​enjoy-binbin](https://redirect.github.com/enjoy-binbin) ([#​3597](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3597))
- Reduce memory usage by sharing pubsub pattern and WATCH key objects across clients subscribing to or watching the same name by [@​enjoy-binbin](https://redirect.github.com/enjoy-binbin) ([#​4072](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4072))
- Large sorted sets are now backed by a B+ tree instead of a skiplist; OBJECT ENCODING reports `btree` instead of `skiplist` by [@​ranshid](https://redirect.github.com/ranshid) ([#​4359](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4359))
- Save the cluster config file from a background thread when `cluster-config-save-behavior` is best-effort, avoiding main-thread latency spikes from slow disk I/O by [@​enjoy-binbin](https://redirect.github.com/enjoy-binbin) ([#​2555](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/2555))
- Speed up `HMGET`, `SMISMEMBER` and `ZMSCORE` on large hashtable-encoded keys with batched lookups that overlap memory accesses by [@​chzhoo](https://redirect.github.com/chzhoo) ([#​4017](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4017))
- Extend memory prefetching to hash, set and sorted set member lookups when io-threads are enabled, improving performance for 30 field/member commands on large keys by [@​roshkhatri](https://redirect.github.com/roshkhatri) ([#​3940](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3940))
- `MEMORY PURGE` now also releases free pages from the glibc main arena back to the OS, reclaiming memory held by libc-internal allocations by [@​webbsssss](https://redirect.github.com/webbsssss) ([#​3640](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3640))
- Speed up command propagation to replicas by batching each command's RESP frame into a single replication buffer write by [@​hpatro](https://redirect.github.com/hpatro) ([#​4044](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4044))
- Reduce lseek system calls during disk-based replication by seeking only when a write blocks or is partial by [@​enjoy-binbin](https://redirect.github.com/enjoy-binbin) ([#​4053](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4053))
- Reduce event-loop overhead by refreshing cached daylight-saving info once per second instead of on every wakeup by [@​hpatro](https://redirect.github.com/hpatro) ([#​4086](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4086))
- Speed up keyspace event notifications by skipping work when there are no subscribers and avoiding unnecessary allocations by [@​enjoy-binbin](https://redirect.github.com/enjoy-binbin) ([#​4285](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4285))
- Speed up exact `XTRIM MAXLEN = 0` by about 2.5x by clearing the whole stream in one step instead of removing entries individually by [@​sarthakaggarwal97](https://redirect.github.com/sarthakaggarwal97) ([#​4161](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4161))
- Cluster bus reads, writes, and inbound TLS accepts can now run on the shared I/O thread pool, with new `CLUSTER INFO` offload statistics by [@​hpatro](https://redirect.github.com/hpatro) ([#​3438](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3438))
- Small hashes with field expiration now use the memory-efficient listpack encoding instead of always converting to a hashtable by [@​frostzt](https://redirect.github.com/frostzt) ([#​3212](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3212))
- Reduce per-command overhead by skipping post-command bookkeeping when no propagation, module, or invalidation work is pending by [@​ahmetalicc](https://redirect.github.com/ahmetalicc) ([#​4257](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4257))

##### Bug Fixes

- Fix `PFMERGE` with no source keys bypassing ACL key permissions and failing in `COMMAND GETKEYS`, and a crash in module commands whose keynum key spec starts past the last argument by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5087](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5087))
- Fix `SCRIPT KILL` and `FUNCTION KILL` not stopping Lua scripts that loop inside nested coroutines, and script timeouts not being detected when work is spread across coroutines by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5108](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5108))
- Fix a server crash in `SORT` and `SORT_RO` with `BY` or `GET` patterns when an element is 2 GiB or larger by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5146](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5146))
- Fix `ValkeyModule_Calloc` and `ValkeyModule_TryCalloc` returning an undersized buffer when `nmemb * size` overflows by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5155](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5155))
- Fix `EXEC` succeeding after a key that was already expired at `WATCH` time is overwritten, which can happen on replicas by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5169](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5169))
- Fix a crash on the first `FUNCTION LOAD` after startup when the shebang engine name contains a NUL byte by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5115](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5115))
- Fix a crash in a cluster replica whose primary was removed from the nodes table when another primary claims an unassigned slot by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5184](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5184))
- Fix an active defrag crash when a large set, sorted set or list is replaced by a hashtable-encoded hash while it is being defragmented by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5164](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5164))
- Fix an out-of-bounds write in `PFADD` and `PFMERGE` on a corrupted sparse HyperLogLog ending in a truncated XZERO opcode by rejecting it as invalid by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5124](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5124))
- Fix a server abort in `PFADD` and `PFMERGE` on short sparse HyperLogLogs when `hll-sparse-max-bytes` is set to 31 or less by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5138](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5138))
- Fix forkless saves writing corrupted set members to the RDB when `ZUNION`, `ZINTER`, `ZINTERCARD` or `ZDIFF` reads the same set concurrently by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5110](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5110))
- Fix a crash when the Lua debugger is started on an empty or newline-only script by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5117](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5117))
- Fix a cluster node failing to restart with an assertion after a gossip entry carrying the MYSELF flag adds a second myself node to nodes.conf by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5134](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5134))
- Fix `ACL LOAD` not disconnecting default user clients subscribed to channels the reloaded rules no longer allow by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5085](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5085))
- Fix a Sentinel crash when a monitored replica's `INFO` reply contains no `master_host` by [@​smkher](https://redirect.github.com/smkher) ([#​4929](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4929))
- Fix throttled write commands being executed twice when using RDMA with IO threads by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5160](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5160))
- Fail `CONFIG REWRITE` when the old config file reads short instead of writing uninitialized memory into the new config file by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5158](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5158))
- Fix Lua `server.error_reply()` returning stale heap memory as the error message when given a string of 2 GiB or more by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5122](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5122))
- Fix a use-after-free in streams when `XADD` creates a new node, which could leave a dangling pointer hit by later reads such as `XRANGE` by [@​Baraa-Hasheesh](https://redirect.github.com/Baraa-Hasheesh) ([#​4711](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4711))
- Fix `XINFO GROUPS` and `XINFO STREAM ... FULL` reporting too-high consumer group lag after `XTRIM` or a trimming `XADD` removes unread entries by [@​Sasidharan3094](https://redirect.github.com/Sasidharan3094) ([#​4983](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4983))
- Fix forkless background iteration being left inside an open `MULTI` after a script or `MULTI`/`EXEC` when there are no replicas and AOF is off by [@​harrylin98](https://redirect.github.com/harrylin98) ([#​5316](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5316))
- Fix use of uninitialized variables in `valkey-cli` cluster key migration when `SELECT` fails on the source node by [@​PoisonGodv](https://redirect.github.com/PoisonGodv) ([#​5311](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5311))
- Fix an assertion failure when `FLUSHALL` or `SHUTDOWN` cancels a failed forkless save that still has a `FLUSHDB` or `SWAPDB` queued by [@​dgershko](https://redirect.github.com/dgershko) ([#​5326](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5326))
- Fix AOF load failure after a crash leaves a torn annotation at the end of the file; it is now treated as a short read and can be truncated by `aof-load-truncated` or `valkey-check-aof --fix` by [@​sumitk163](https://redirect.github.com/sumitk163) ([#​5349](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5349))
- Fix Lua `server.log()` blocking the server for seconds when called with thousands of arguments, with no `-BUSY` reply or `SCRIPT KILL` by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5104](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5104))
- Bound the number of memory regions the crash report's fast memory test records on Linux to avoid overflowing its region list by [@​JimB123](https://redirect.github.com/JimB123) ([#​5379](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5379))
- Fix a replica assertion when a timed-out script ends while the replication throttler holds the primary client, possible right after a failover with `repl-throttling-enabled yes` by [@​asagege](https://redirect.github.com/asagege) ([#​5389](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5389))
- Fix a primary assertion when `FLUSHDB` runs right at the end of a forkless full sync by [@​sarthakaggarwal97](https://redirect.github.com/sarthakaggarwal97) ([#​5365](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5365))
- Fix a primary assertion when a module thread holding the GIL performs a replicated write during a forkless save or full sync; affects modules that set `VALKEYMODULE_OPTIONS_HANDLE_FORKLESS` by [@​Baraa-Hasheesh](https://redirect.github.com/Baraa-Hasheesh) ([#​5432](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5432))
- Fix `CONFIG SET priority-subnets` demoting replica and slot migration connections from high priority, and fix drift in the active priority client counter by [@​satheeshaGowda](https://redirect.github.com/satheeshaGowda) ([#​4681](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4681))
- Fix a source primary assertion on the next `CLUSTER MIGRATESLOTS` and a pipe descriptor leak after a slot migration snapshot fails to fork, such as during a forkless BGSAVE by [@​Baraa-Hasheesh](https://redirect.github.com/Baraa-Hasheesh) ([#​5359](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5359))
- Fix excessive copy-on-write memory during fork-based saves and a data race in forkless saves under an LFU `maxmemory-policy` by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​5445](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5445))
- Fix a use-after-free crash when a blocked client's re-executed command evicts the client still executing a command under `maxmemory-clients` by [@​nadav-levanoni](https://redirect.github.com/nadav-levanoni) ([#​5435](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5435))
- Fix access to a freed database when `FLUSHDB` and `SWAPDB` in the same transaction terminate a background iteration by [@​JimB123](https://redirect.github.com/JimB123) ([#​5462](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5462))
- Reject module write commands while the server is paused for writes, preventing a crash from module timer callbacks during `CLIENT PAUSE WRITE` or `CLUSTER FAILOVER` by [@​smkher](https://redirect.github.com/smkher) ([#​3645](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3645))
- Fix event loop busy-spinning on virtual machines by not using raw TSC for the monotonic clock when the kernel clocksource is not tsc by [@​quanyeyang](https://redirect.github.com/quanyeyang) ([#​4707](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4707))
- Fix a crash in `ValkeyModule_HashHasStringRef` on a missing or expired field and correct wrong return values in the hash stringRef module APIs by [@​ShubhamTaple](https://redirect.github.com/ShubhamTaple) ([#​4504](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4504))
- Fix a server abort on a RESTORE payload declaring a string length that overflows the allocation size; such payloads are now rejected as bad data by [@​enjoy-binbin](https://redirect.github.com/enjoy-binbin) ([#​4733](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4733))
- Fix ZINTER/ZINTERSTORE returning input-order-dependent scores when a weighted term is 0\*inf; a NaN weighted score now counts as 0, matching ZUNION by [@​leomurillo](https://redirect.github.com/leomurillo) ([#​4997](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4997))
